text:
ellie.partnerships: Quick sync 52AstraGrid reached out to co-host a hands-on session + micro-lab at CloudCon EU. They want a Marketplace tile push aligned to the talk. Can we assign owners and call out hard deadlines? :tada:
morgan.events: Nice. What are their must-haves?
ellie.partnerships: Two slots: 15m product intro + 30m joint live integration. On-site: 4 demo stations (BlueForge loaners) plus 1 presenter station. Marketplace tile + short demo video. CC in FR + ES.
sam.engineer: For the live integration we'll need a reproducible runbook and a fallback that doesn't require GPUs (static demo + recorded session). Also need a sandbox API key and a small, pinned model artifact.
jules.astragrid: I can lead the integration demo (AstraGrid connector). Will prepare a trimmed demo script and a Docker container. Need the sandbox creds and a sample dataset by Mon.
rina.design: Artwork question 120 tote bags vs pins? We should pick one. Also need tile image (600x400) + 2 thumbnail options. Deadline for print art to meet EU shipping: 10 business days.
devon.logistics: Tote bags are heavier to ship; pins are lighter and cheaper for customs. EU courier cutoff for printed goods is 12 days from ship date. Who signs the PO?
morgan.events: If budget allows, do both but smaller qty: pins x120 + totes x80. Ill raise the PO tomorrow AM. Rina, can you do art mockups by Thu EOD?
rina.design: Yep, Ill drop options by Thu. Which brand lockups do we need? Co-branded lockup plus a single-color variant for small prints.
jules.astragrid: Also: demo reliability is critical. If BlueForge units are delayed we fallback to local VM-based demo and a livestream of the connector. Ill include a short pre-recorded failover clip (~60s).
sam.engineer: Dry-run windows: Wed 09:00-10:30 UTC (EU friendly) and Fri 02:00-04:00 UTC (APAC). Dry-runs must exercise: 1) container deploy, 2) plugin install, 3) simulated GPU failure -> show fallback. Add time for captions test.
ellie.partnerships: Speakers list: me (opening + product direction), Jules (integration demo), AstraGrid PM (marketplace talk). AstraGrid PM wants a ~5min segment on discoverability and co-marketing.
jules.astragrid: Confirmed. Ill share slides and a 2-sentence customer quote.
devon.logistics: Captioning: options LiveSubs (FR/ES) or platform auto-sub. LiveSubs quoted k. Recommend LiveSubs given audience.
morgan.events: Approve LiveSubs. Add to budget. Also need headshots + 60-80 word bios from speakers by Tue.
sam.engineer: Marketplace launch ops: we need tile assets (600x400), a 90s demo video, and a short blurb (20-30 words). If we go live same day, coordinate the canary route and a token-limited demo pool. Ops please confirm access window.
jules.astragrid: We can provide the demo video and blurb by Fri. Also need the marketplace link structure and any tagging requirements.
sam.engineer: I can provision a demo pool: plan for 3 small GPU nodes for the live hour, with a fallback autoscale to 0 and a static demo page. Tell me expected concurrent sessions.
jules.astragrid: Expect ~30 concurrent demo users at peak. Prompts will be lightweight.
devon.logistics: Shipping manifest to prepare: pins x120, totes x80, courier labels, commercial invoice, local pickup at venue. Ill schedule pickup and share tracking.
ellie.partnerships: Promo timeline: registration open D-21, blog + joint tweet D-7, marketplace tile D0. AstraGrid to submit PR blurbs + logo by Tue.
morgan.events: Ill spin up the event page draft and share for review. Also coordinating BlueForge handcarry for 4 units; if they canft well source local rentals.
sam.engineer: Runbook snippet to include for dry-run: ```# demo healthcheck
curl -sS https://sandbox.redwood.ai/health || show_fallback_page()```
jules.astragrid: Ill upload the Docker image & demo creds by EOD Mon and pin them in the shared folder.
ops-bot: demo-pool request #4072 scheduled: 3 GPU nodes reserved 2026-06-18T09:00:00Z -> 2026-06-18T12:30:00Z.
ellie.partnerships: Sweet. Action owners: Morgan (PO + page), Rina (art), Devon (swag + customs), Sam (demo pool + runbook), Jules (slides + docker + creds). Ill consolidate timeline and send calendar invites for dry-runs. :rocket:
